description: Finds repetition that makes a page harder to scan by ear. Pass a public `url` or `html`. Reports: a heading and a link with the same text in the same region or close in reading order (for example a section heading and a "see all" link with the same words); duplicate heading text within a region; links with the same text going to different destinations; the same link repeated to one destination; multiple navigation, complementary, region or search landmarks without distinct names; more than one main, banner or contentinfo; and duplicate id values. Headings and links that are aria-hidden or hidden are skipped, because a browser leaves them out of the accessibility tree, and the count of skipped items is stated. Reads delivered markup only: CSS-hidden duplicates (desktop and mobile navs), shadow DOM and script-built content are not handled.

html.description: HTML source to check instead of a URL.

url.description: A public page URL to fetch.

name: repeated_label_check
title: Repeated labels check
